items.q: add Bill Beeson to the band... Chick wasn't with us anymore so we had to reset his solos... we have to reset everything

ctx.x: In other words, before Chick Webb died, Big Sid and sometimes Bill Beeson --
Bill Beeson. Big Sid Catlett made all the trips with us.
